title: Returned-Payment Fee Amount — Home Comfort Financing
content:
## Amount of the fee

The returned-payment fee on a Home Comfort Financing account is the scheduled returned-payment fee reduced once by the returned-payment relief percentage, never below zero, and rounded to the cent half up only at the end. The scheduled returned-payment fee is the plan's returned-payment fee, and the returned-payment relief percentage is zero.

Stated as a figure: the fee is the scheduled returned-payment fee multiplied by the difference between 100 and the returned-payment relief percentage, divided by 100; a result below zero is taken as zero; the result is rounded to the cent, half up, once.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Scheduled returned-payment fee | Relief percentage | Fee before rounding | Fee posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| $25.00 | zero | $25.00 | $25.00 |

## Points of judgement

- One fee is charged for each returned payment, and this amount applies to that one fee.
- The fee is never negative: the floor of zero applies before rounding.
- Rounding to the cent happens once, on the final figure.
